scope.priority: L4 first; raw endpoint delta is disclosed priority evidence, not a runtime or acoustic gate

policies.exactMatch: Existing NFKC+CJK literal comparison; no script/phonetic/erhua substitutions
policies.crop: two-model raw-range union with fixed 120ms before and 150ms after; integer floor/ceil frames
policies.neighborGate: both models previous.end <= crop.start and next.start >= crop.end; adjacent semantic word probability >= .5
policies.blockedTrack: L5 track2 existing severe medium hallucination; no new word targets
policies.warning: Author gates are conservative filters, not calibrated ASR, phonetic or human-listening certification
